comparison_rule: Compare each tested setting against the 16 angstrom reference in the same runner. Use A01 AV03 energy and force thresholds and AV05/AV06 electron count thresholds. Apply both four- and six-point density L1 estimates when the grids differ. Record individual force components and full signed CUBE statistics.
scope_limits: Fixed neutral singlet fixtures with one x86 CP2K PBE/GAPW/cc-pVDZ image. The C02 bond length is 0.74144 angstrom from the authored coordinates; no requirement of zero PBE force is imposed.
The finite 16 angstrom reference is a comparison endpoint for each fixture. The matched-cutoff 12 to 16 angstrom check does not establish 16 to 20 angstrom equivalence at these new geometries.
This is a numerical screening experiment. Formal family convergence, independent physical validation, boundary geometry coverage, and OCI operational validation remain separate.
